text:
Alex: Heads up — HHC renewal is next Tue. Customer asked for a pricing rebaseline: they want their baseline uplifted by ~30% and to reprice committed rates. Current contract has RateCard_v1 with a 15% standard volume discount. I think we should consider a special commit with a short-term credit to smooth the uplift.

Maria: Do we have current 90d consumption vs committed baseline? Also any outstanding security or POC blockers that could derail signoff?

Alex: Sending numbers in a sec. 90d shows 1.4x baseline. They forecast 1.7x for next year. POC is still live but working; SEs say quality is fine.

Sam: POC update — latency and generate quality are fine. We recommended KV caching + batching config which drops token cost ~18% on their workload. Will hand over the eval report by EOD Thu. That helps justify offering an optimized price for longer commit.

Priya: For the commercial ask: they want a 30% uplift to baseline and a counter-proposal of 20% discount on hosted API. My proposed options to present to customer:
- Option A: 12mo, 1.6x commit, 18% discount, $50k one-time credit to offset migration/ops
- Option B: 24mo, 1.7x commit, 23% discount, $100k credit + priority rollout windows
Need deal-desk approval for any >20% discount or one-off credits.

Evan: Security questionnaire still has 2 open items: data retention policy and KMS integration proof. Those are gating for some legal teams but HHC has SOC2 infra already; we can provide the KMS attestation by tomorrow.

Maria: Okay. To escalate: we need deal desk signoff for Option B (23% + credit). Provide business justification: strategic reference account, upsell potential, retention risk if pricing not competitive. Also include POC results and cost savings from caching — that reduces our unit economics impact.

Priya: I've drafted the justification doc and will attach the P&L impact numbers. Quick ask to Deal Desk: can we get fast-track review? This is a renewal, not net-new, and the account is at-risk if we can't match market comps.

Deal Desk Bot: New request created DD-4321 by Priya. Required approvals: Finance Manager + VP Sales. Queue: expedited.

Alex: FYI -- competitor quoted 22% discount for a 24mo commit. We're competitive if we approve Option B with the credit.

Maria: Finance — can you confirm the maximum allowable credit% for renewals without additional legal terms? If not, we need to route to legal for special terms.

Evan: I'll push the KMS attestation now and email security@redwood. That should clear the remaining SOC2 item.

Sam: I'll attach the POC benchmark csv and the recommended batching config (snippet):
```
batch_size: auto
kv_cache: enabled
prefix_cache: true
quant_profile: q4_0
```
This reduces token spend while keeping latency in SLO.

Priya: Thanks — I'll upload all artifacts to DD-4321. If Deal Desk approves fast-track, I'll send the updated commercial term sheet to HHC by EOD Fri.

Deal Desk Bot: DD-4321 assigned to Maria. Estimated SLA for expedited queue: 48 hours.

Maria: Got it. If Finance signs off, I will route to VP Sales for final approval. Please call out retention risk and strategic reference in the approval note. 

Priya: Noted. I also added a mitigation: we offer a 60-day performance SLA credit if baseline not met after uplift. That should reduce risk for Redwood.

Alex: Perfect. Keep me posted — I'll continue customer comms and try to get verbal hold on the competitor quote.

Deal Desk Bot: DD-4321 status updated: under review (Finance).
